title: Oscar Pettiford, Stan Getz and other musicians in Scandinavia
summary: He tells of Pettiford's car accident and meetings with Getz in Copenhagen, a trumpeter named Bailey, and a pianist, to whom he praised Sharkey Bonano.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
